transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this weekly facilities huddle started. We've got four operating areas that need generator power in the next 24 hours — the clinic, communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance workshop — and only two 60-kilowatt generators, G-1 and G-2, which cannot be run in parallel. Before I sign off on any schedule, I need each of you — medical, signal, facilities, and logistics — to state every changed operating requirement, timing constraint, or circuit-control requirement from your current logs. Nothing assumed, nothing left off the table. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to put a changed circuit-control requirement on the table. I confirmed the connection with the clinic technician this morning, but this circuit change is not yet reflected on the facilities drawing.

transcript.text: I have a changed timing and circuit-control requirement to put on the table. The next fuel delivery will arrive at exactly 1700 tomorrow, and fuel on hand only supports G-2 for 16 operating hours. To preserve communications and clinic continuity, G-2 must be scheduled offline from exactly 0100 to 0900 tomorrow, with the workshop remaining on G-1 after its inspection window. I received the carrier confirmation this morning, but the revised fuel timing has not been posted to the power plan.
